scope: Independent read-only review of the explicit unused settled-projection source bridge. One authorized in-memory AST mutation confirmed an inert-binding loophole; pipeline repaired it and reran the same-source proof. No game/browser/matrix run or product edit by this reviewer.

resolvedFinding.before: The inert predicate only inspected the const initializer. An empty-array initializer passed while an array/object binding default or computed property could execute at module load. The actual product module did not contain such a statement.
resolvedFinding.independentReproduction: Original frozen baseline and the added destructuring mutation both returned pass in an AST-only helper call; the side-effect expression itself was never run.
resolvedFinding.repair: Each top-level const declaration must now have an Identifier name before the unchanged inert initializer check. Pipeline added array-default, object-default and computed-object-key negative cases; all14 cases pass.
resolvedFinding.assessment: The confirmed binding-initializer hole is closed without changing accepted actual runtime code or broadening any source exception.
